items.title: Did Berkshire Hathaway’s $6.8 Billion Bet Misjudge the Housing Market — Again?
items.summary: Greg Abel just committed $6.8 billion to homebuilders while mortgage rates hover near 7% and builder sentiment sits at multi-year lows. Whether that looks like bold contrarian conviction or a costly miscalculation depends on what happens next.
